title: bath rug
text: bath rug. Came FOLDED in quarters.  Won't wash or dry out.  I'm going to toss it.  REALLY disappointed.  WHY would you fold something as cheap as this - just to save on shipping I guess.  But in the long run it was a HUGE waste of money.  Back to the regular bath mat that you can wash and dry and doesn't look folded!
